impersonation_prompt: [OOC: This is the explicit exception to the user-autonomy rule. Write your next reply from the point of view of <user>, using the chat history so far as a guideline for <user>'s writing style. Don't write as {{char}} or as the system. Don't describe actions of {{char}}.]
new_group_chat_prompt: [Start a new group chat. Group members: {{group}}]
continue_nudge_prompt: [Continue the following message. Do not include ANY parts of the original message. Use capitalization and punctuation as if your reply is a part of the original message: {{lastChatMessage}}]
assistant_prefill: Okay, I must start my reply, following the instructions, and using the Council of Vex to reason
nemo_merge_note:
Nemo Engine v11.5.2 — targeted control, resolver, display, and cleanup patch.
- Reasoning boundary: after plan-close repair, any completed </think>, </thinking>, </plan>, or </planning> wipes everything from the beginning of that message through the final closing tag in both display and prompt-context paths. The intentional assistant prefill/reasoning behavior is unchanged.
- User Role Modes: explicit five-way single-select control with User is a Character enabled as the visible default, followed by Cowriter, Anime Cowriter, Director Mode, and User as Director.
- Scratchpad resolver: Variable Init clears NemoPadLoader; every optional Pad Tab and the explicit Modular base load the same complete Modular Scratchpad into that variable; the mandatory hidden resolver sits below them and emits the selected loader once. Consequence remains a passive default-on contributor and is ordered above every loader setter.
- Machinery display: Visible is the shipped default; Hidden removes <scene>, <nemo-pad>, and <pad> containers only from rendered Markdown while retaining their raw continuity state for later prompts.

Previous release note:
Nemo Engine v11.5.1 — General RP default.
Base: v11.3 + Magpie systems (central shared-interval turn contract; in-scene character turn simulation; optional terminal Draft+Attack; Magpie frame; optional character/location/object files; modular Nemo scratchpad; complete seven-mode Consequence family; the Magpie display/repair regex layer adapted to Nemo grammar; and a guaranteed final user-role runtime tail placed last in every prompt-order profile). Dialogue-colour and voice-colour marker systems are intentionally excluded.
Shipped configuration: Omega core tier throughout (Narration, Speech, Character, Development, Grounding, Knowledge, Narrative); a single narrator voice (Narrative Vex); Anime world logic; Consequence Core with The Epilogue; Balanced difficulty; modern NSFW Core; Main Plan with the stock planning steps; Third Person Omniscient, NPC Interiority ON, Present Tense, Long responses; and the standard utility, tracker and databank layer.
Regex layer: the Magpie/Nemo display and repair scripts, trackers, Vex commentary and emoji FX are present; the Slopfix anti-cliche substitution bank is not shipped in this build.
Deliberately off by default: every narrative frame (Cowriter, Anime Cowriter, Magpie, Retro), genre locks, author influences, prose-format overrides, the Anime Archetypes Engine, anime erotica calibration, Council Plan, and both CYOA variants. Turn on what your story needs.

Scratchpad Legacy (2026-08-14): the pre-v11.4 monolithic Scene Scratchpad was restored from _backup_nemo_published/preset_prompts.json as a separate prompt (identifier nemo_pad_legacy). The v11.4+ pad was renamed Scratchpad Modular and keeps its original identifier. The two write the same panel — enable only one. Both are off by default, as the pad slot was in v11.5.1.
